1: open this document in VScode.  
2: when prompted (or manually under Extensions with `CTRL` + `SHIFT` + `X`),
   install the Quarto extension (and on MacOS the CLI).  
3: restart VScode.  
4: click the Preview button (topright) to render (a.k.a. compile) the file.

## Section title

This is a mini [quarto](https://quarto.org/) document with text and some R code.  

Rendering as instructed above will execute the code chunks and weave together the text, code and output.

```{r, plot_example, echo=TRUE}
pairs(iris[, 1:4], main="Anderson's Iris Data",
      col=c("orange", "salmon", "lightblue")[iris$Species], 
	  pch=16, cex=1.5, lower.panel=NULL, las=1)
```

More in lesson i.2, specifically the homework.
